boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain George Washington University
boards.description: Ten named, under-21-safe food stops on or near the Foggy Bottom campus with currently posted evening availability.

cards.title: Carvings
cards.subtitle: 2021 F Street NW, near Foggy Bottom campus
cards.notes: Use the posted hours before leaving; this campus-adjacent deli lists service through midnight Sunday–Wednesday and later on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-adjacent deli with posted midnight-and-later hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Carvings lists hours of 8 AM–midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 8 AM–2 AM Thursday, and 8 AM–3 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Carvings — Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Wed 8 AM–12 AM; Thu 8 AM–2 AM; Fri–Sat 8 AM–3 AM. Confirm before visiting.

cards.title: DC Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1103 19th Street NW, Golden Triangle
cards.notes: Plan this for the late-week window and check the restaurant page first; the official listing gives Thursday through Saturday late-night closing times.
cards.short_summary: A 19th Street pizza stop with official late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: DC Pizza lists Thursday hours until 3 AM and Friday–Saturday hours until 4 AM.
cards.source_title: DC Pizza — Find Us
cards.access_notes: Posted late hours: Thursday until 3 AM; Friday and Saturday until 4 AM. Other days close at 9 PM.

cards.title: University Student Center
cards.subtitle: 800 21st Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the semester dining schedule and head to the first floor when its listed late window is active; hours vary by day and academic period.
cards.short_summary: GW’s student center is a documented late campus dining location.
cards.evidence_claim: GW Dining’s Fall 2025 schedule lists University Student Center retail dining until 11 PM Monday–Wednesday and until 1 AM Thursday–Friday.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — Fall 2025 Hours of Operations
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted retail hours: Mon–Wed 11 AM–11 PM; Thu–Fri 11 AM–1 AM. Schedule is semester-specific; confirm current hours.

cards.title: District House
cards.subtitle: 2121 H Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use the posted dining schedule and the building’s named food options for an on-campus evening meal; confirm the day’s hours before you go.
cards.short_summary: A GW dining building with four named quick-service concepts.
cards.evidence_claim: GW identifies District House at 2121 H Street NW and lists D.C. Taco House, Baba’s Pizza, Halal Shack, and True Burger; its Fall 2025 schedule lists 11 AM–9 PM daily.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — District House
cards.access_notes: GW’s Fall 2025 hours document lists District House retail dining daily from 11 AM–9 PM. Confirm current schedule before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Panda Express at Science & Engineering Hall
cards.title: Panda Express at Science & Engineering Hall
cards.subtitle: 800 22nd Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the current GW dining schedule before heading over; this named campus location’s posted daily service window extends into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A named retail dining option inside GW’s Science & Engineering Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: GW Dining’s Fall 2025 schedule lists Panda Express at Science & Engineering Hall, 800 22nd Street NW, from 10:30 AM to 11 PM Monday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — Fall 2025 Hours of Operations
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted hours: 10:30 AM–11 PM daily. Schedule is semester-specific; confirm current hours.

cards.title: Shenkman Hall Dining
cards.subtitle: 616 23rd Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Consult the current dining schedule before setting out; Shenkman combines all-you-care-to-eat dining, Sushi Do, and a market in one named campus building.
cards.short_summary: An evening dining hall and market location at GW.
cards.evidence_claim: GW identifies Shenkman Hall at 616 23rd Street NW and its Fall 2025 schedule lists dinner until 10 PM Monday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — Shenkman Hall
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted dining-hall dinner ends at 10 PM Monday–Thursday; Friday and weekend schedules differ. Confirm current hours.

cards.title: Thurston Hall Dining
cards.subtitle: 1900 F Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the dining calendar before an evening visit; this named GW dining hall has a posted weeknight dinner service ending at 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A named Foggy Bottom dining hall with documented evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: GW Dining’s Fall 2025 schedule lists Thurston at 1900 F Street NW with dinner served until 10 PM Monday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — Fall 2025 Hours of Operations
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted dinner hours: Monday–Thursday until 10 PM; Friday until 9 PM; weekend schedule differs. Confirm current hours.

cards.title: Andy’s Pizza — Foggy Bottom
cards.subtitle: 2000 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Lobby 014
cards.notes: Use the location page for the day’s service window; this named Foggy Bottom shop posts the same 10 PM close every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Foggy Bottom pizza shop with a consistent posted nightly closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Andy’s Pizza lists its Foggy Bottom location at 2000 Pennsylvania Avenue NW and posts daily hours of 11 AM–10 PM.
cards.source_title: Andy's Pizza — Foggy Bottom Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 AM–10 PM Monday–Sunday. Confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Western Market
cards.subtitle: 2000 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the market and individual stall schedules before walking over; the market posts 10 PM closing daily, while vendors may keep different hours.
cards.short_summary: A named Foggy Bottom food hall open until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Western Market identifies itself as located in Foggy Bottom and posts hours until 10 PM daily, noting that individual stalls may vary.
cards.source_title: Western Market DC
cards.access_notes: Posted market hours: 7 AM–10 PM weekdays and 8 AM–10 PM weekends; individual stalls may vary. Confirm before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bodega Taqueria y Tequila — Foggy Bottom
cards.title: Bodega Taqueria — Foggy Bottom
cards.subtitle: 2127 I Street NW, near GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use the taqueria service hours rather than event listings, and verify the day before going; its food counter posts late weekday and weekend availability.
cards.short_summary: A named I Street taqueria with official midnight-and-later service windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Bodega’s Foggy Bottom location lists taqueria hours through midnight Monday–Wednesday, 1 AM Thursday, 2 AM Friday, and 3 AM Saturday.
cards.source_title: Bodega Taqueria y Tequila — Foggy Bottom
cards.access_notes: Posted taqueria hours: Mon–Wed until 12 AM, Thu until 1 AM, Fri until 2 AM, Sat until 3 AM; Sunday is listed closed for summer. Confirm current hours.

warnings: GW’s published campus dining hours are semester-specific; each campus card’s access notes instructs visitors to confirm the current schedule.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named GW destinations for studying, meeting, recreation, performances, and campus-day pauses, with access details checked against current public sources.

cards.title: University Student Center
cards.subtitle: 800 21st St. NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use the ground or fourth-floor study areas for a change of scene, and check the building page before planning a meeting or event.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building with study, meeting, presentation, dining, and outdoor space.
cards.evidence_claim: GW identifies the University Student Center as Foggy Bottom’s main hub and says it provides spaces for students to study, work, and socialize.
cards.source_title: University Student Center | Division for Student Affairs | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: GW lists tap access beginning at 10 p.m. daily; public building hours and event access can change.

cards.title: Gelman Library
cards.subtitle: 2130 H Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Choose a reading lounge, group room, or the Writing Center depending on the task; bring your GWorld card for library access.
cards.short_summary: GW’s main library combines research help with reading lounges and group-study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: GW describes Gelman as its main library, equipped with student and reading lounges, group study rooms, and the University Writing Center.
cards.source_title: Academic Support | School of Medicine and Health Sciences | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: GW says Gelman access is available to students, faculty, staff, sponsored visiting scholars, and alumni; check library hours separately.

cards.title: Kogan Plaza
cards.subtitle: Mid-Campus Quad & Kogan Plaza, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use this named mid-campus plaza as an outdoor waypoint between nearby buildings, then consult the campus map for the closest accessible entrance.
cards.short_summary: A named plaza within GW’s Mid-Campus Quad destination.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map lists “Mid-Campus Quad & Kogan Plaza” as a Foggy Bottom campus location.
cards.source_title: Virtual Tour Map | Explore GW | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is generally weather-dependent; follow any posted event or campus-use guidance.

cards.title: University Yard
cards.subtitle: University Yard, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Make this named outdoor campus stop a meeting point before heading into adjacent academic buildings; use posted routes and accessible entrances.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed outdoor destination on the Foggy Bottom campus.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map lists University Yard among its Foggy Bottom campus locations.
cards.source_title: Virtual Tour Map | Explore GW | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to weather and scheduled campus activity.

cards.title: District House
cards.subtitle: 2121 H Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: For a small group gathering, look into eligible B-level space reservations rather than assuming a room is open when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A named campus building with reservable District House spaces for eligible students and organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: GW states that individual students may reserve B-level District House spaces and that reservations can be made when space is available.
cards.source_title: Student Center Space Requirements | Division for Student Affairs | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Reservations and availability rules apply; GW’s building list gives accessible entries from I Street and H Street.

cards.title: Science and Engineering Hall
cards.subtitle: 800 22nd Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: If you need a small table-based work session, check the study-space portal for SEH rooms before going; same-day requests are supported.
cards.short_summary: A Foggy Bottom academic building with bookable small study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: GW lists SEH 1230, 1240, 1250, and 1260 as study spaces and says requests may be submitted the same day before the desired time.
cards.source_title: Space Scheduling | GW Events & Venues | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Study-space reservations depend on availability; campus-map information lists several accessible SEH entrances.

cards.title: Lerner Health and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: 2301 G Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Plan a drop-in recreation visit around the facility schedule and bring the required credentials; review Campus Recreation rules before using the space.
cards.short_summary: GW’s recreation facility for eligible students and members.
cards.evidence_claim: GW states that the Lerner Health and Wellness Center is open to GW students and LWHC members for drop-in recreation.
cards.source_title: Campus Rec Facilities & Hours of Operation | Division for Student Affairs | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to GW students and LWHC members for drop-in recreation; confirm current facility hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: The George Washington University Museum and The Textile Museum
cards.title: GW Museum and The Textile Museum
cards.subtitle: 701 21st Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Set aside time to view the museum’s textile-focused collections, and confirm the day’s visitor details before walking over from campus.
cards.short_summary: A GW museum destination focused on global textiles and related arts.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map identifies The George Washington University Museum and The Textile Museum as a Foggy Bottom campus location.
cards.source_title: Virtual Tour Map | Explore GW | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s current visitor information for gallery hours, exhibitions, and any access conditions.

cards.title: Lisner Auditorium
cards.subtitle: 730 21st Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Watch the university calendar for a specific performance or campus program, then follow that event’s ticketing and entry instructions.
cards.short_summary: A named Foggy Bottom auditorium and university event venue.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map lists Lisner Auditorium as a Foggy Bottom campus location, and GW’s scheduling page includes it in student-organization event portals.
cards.source_title: Space Scheduling | GW Events & Venues | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Access is event-specific; a reservation, ticket, or invitation may be required depending on the program.

cards.title: Eckles Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 2100 Foxhall Road NW, Mount Vernon Campus
cards.notes: Use the library’s computer lab or study space during a Mount Vernon visit, and verify the day’s hours before taking campus transportation.
cards.short_summary: A Mount Vernon library with study space and a 24-hour computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: GW states that Eckles Library houses a 24-hour computer lab and study space.
cards.source_title: Academic Support | School of Medicine and Health Sciences | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: GW lists library access for students, faculty, and staff; confirm building and service hours before visiting.

warnings: Several destinations have eligibility, reservation, or event-specific access; verify current details before visiting.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Foggy Bottom and National Mall corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Read the names on the Vietnam Veterans Memorial
cards.subtitle: Constitution Avenue NW corridor
cards.notes: Walk the black-granite walls at the west end of the National Mall and use the chronological inscriptions for a quiet, self-guided stop.
cards.short_summary: Maya Lin’s memorial uses two angled granite walls inscribed with names.
cards.evidence_claim: The NPS describes the memorial’s two polished black-granite walls, which carry the names of service members lost or missing in the Vietnam War.
cards.source_title: Vietnam Veterans Memorial
cards.access_notes: Outdoor National Mall memorial; follow posted site guidance.

cards.entity_name: Vietnam Veterans Memorial: Three Servicemen Statue
cards.title: Study the Three Servicemen sculpture
cards.subtitle: Constitution Avenue NW corridor
cards.notes: Find Frederick Hart’s three-figure bronze beside the Vietnam memorial and compare its human-scale detail with the nearby wall.
cards.short_summary: A bronze sculpture added to the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in 1984.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS states that the Three Servicemen statue was added in 1984 and depicts three American servicemen and the things they carried.
cards.source_title: Vietnam Veterans Memorial: Three Servicemen Statue
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial area; follow posted site guidance.

cards.title: Pause at the Vietnam Women’s Memorial
cards.subtitle: Constitution Avenue NW corridor
cards.notes: Visit the bronze group south of the Vietnam Veterans Memorial and take time to notice the three women caring for a wounded soldier.
cards.short_summary: A figurative memorial recognizing women who served during the Vietnam War.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS identifies the Vietnam Women’s Memorial as a sculpture of three uniformed women caring for a wounded male soldier.
cards.source_title: Vietnam Women’s Memorial
cards.access_notes: Outdoor National Mall memorial; follow posted site guidance.

cards.entity_name: Vietnam Veterans Memorial: In Memory Plaque
cards.title: Find the In Memory plaque
cards.subtitle: Constitution Avenue NW corridor
cards.notes: Look in the northeast corner of the Three Servicemen plaza for this later addition honoring Vietnam veterans who died from service-related causes.
cards.short_summary: A 2004 plaque expands the memorial’s act of remembrance.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS says the In Memory plaque, dedicated in 2004, honors Vietnam veterans who later died from causes related to the war.
cards.source_title: Vietnam Veterans Memorial: In Memory Plaque
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial area; follow posted site guidance.

cards.title: Cross to Signers Island
cards.subtitle: Constitution Avenue NW corridor
cards.notes: Use the footbridge on the north side of the pond to reach the memorial to the 56 signers of the Declaration of Independence.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped park with a pond, paths, and an island memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS notes that Constitution Gardens has a pond and that Signers Island, with its 56-signers memorial, is reached by footbridge.
cards.source_title: Constitution Gardens: Basic Information
cards.access_notes: NPS lists the site as open 24 hours; facilities may close in the evening.

cards.title: Step into the Lincoln Memorial chamber
cards.subtitle: 23rd Street NW corridor
cards.notes: Approach from the Reflecting Pool and view the seated Lincoln statue and interior inscriptions in the memorial’s main chamber.
cards.short_summary: The chamber is the principal public space within the Lincoln Memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS states that the Lincoln Memorial is free and open to the public, including the chamber with the Lincoln statue and symbolic features.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Memorial: Fees & Passes
cards.access_notes: The main memorial is free; the lower-level museum and undercroft require timed entry.

cards.title: Follow the 19-statue patrol
cards.subtitle: 23rd Street NW corridor
cards.notes: Walk the memorial’s Field of Service and look for the nineteen stainless-steel figures whose reflections create an image of thirty-eight.
cards.short_summary: A memorial with a field of stainless-steel soldier figures and reflective surfaces.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS describes nineteen stainless-steel statues whose reflections create the visual effect of 38 figures.
cards.source_title: Korean War Veterans Memorial
cards.access_notes: NPS lists the memorial as open 24 hours a day, every day of the year.

cards.title: Look up inside the DC War Memorial
cards.subtitle: Independence Avenue SW corridor
cards.notes: Step beneath the open circular pavilion south of the Reflecting Pool and look for the names carved around its marble base.
cards.short_summary: A local World War I memorial designed as an open Doric pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS identifies this as a World War I memorial with an open circular Doric structure and the names of 499 honored Washingtonians.
cards.source_title: District of Columbia War Memorial
cards.access_notes: Outdoor National Mall memorial; follow posted site guidance.

cards.title: Walk the World War II Memorial plaza
cards.subtitle: 17th Street NW corridor
cards.notes: Enter the memorial between the Lincoln Memorial and Washington Monument and trace the state and territorial pillars around the central fountain.
cards.short_summary: A National Mall memorial positioned between the Lincoln Memorial and Washington Monument.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS includes the World War II Memorial among the sites preserved by National Mall and Memorial Parks.
cards.source_title: Visit National Mall and Memorial Parks
cards.access_notes: Outdoor National Mall memorial; follow posted site guidance.

cards.title: Visit the Albert Einstein Memorial
cards.subtitle: Constitution Avenue NW corridor
cards.notes: Stop at the National Academy of Sciences grounds to see the Einstein memorial, unveiled for the centennial of the scientist’s birth.
cards.short_summary: A memorial sculpture on the National Academy of Sciences grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Academy of Sciences states that the Albert Einstein Memorial was unveiled in 1979 and stands on the Academy grounds.
cards.source_title: National Academy of Sciences Locations
cards.access_notes: The memorial is on Academy grounds; the NAS Building itself is closed to the public except for authorized visitors.
